digest.component_or_area: Jira status mapping and reconciliation core
propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded with no echo-safe path for projects needing remaps or collapse; it must become config-driven per-project via the S1 mapping core.
Unmapped local statuses must drift (omit Jira field unchanged) with deduped non-fatal warnings, never coerce or fail.

Remapped and collapsed status pairs must round-trip losslessly via rebar-status:<local> labels using a generalized stamp rule keyed on config.jira_to_local_status, recovered inbound without requiring a reverse map.
The outbound mapper seam must resolve per-project effective status maps from [mapping] config in the repo root and thread the resolved map through CREATE and UPDATE codepaths.
Config-declared status names must be added to the fetcher known-set and preflight validation to tolerate remapped Jira statuses absent from built-in maps.
The hardcoded _REBAR_STATUS_LABEL_TO_LOCAL literal must be retired for a shared derived helper re-exported in applier.__all__, with recovery vocab covering every local status the stamp rule emits.
